name: Dust Motes
desc: Slow-drifting motes catching light in the air — a near-still ambient haze of soft glowing specks that twinkle and wander, from warm bokeh to a raking sunbeam to falling ash to a cyan velocity-vector schematic.

hue.doc: mote hue (45=warm amber; try 200 cool, 30 gold)

style.doc: render philosophy: warm soft bokeh / volumetric light shaft with motes / pale falling ash (desaturated, somber) / non-representational cyan velocity-vector blueprint markers

act.doc: multi-minute program: drift gentle lateral float / updraft motes rise / settle motes sink and thin
